dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Chosen One, Chosen of Dragons...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Sacred Mountain lies before you... If... that is... you can eliminate the enemy cloaked in shadow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Chosen of Dragons... Enter... Enter the Sacred Mountain...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No... It's been super duper quiet... D—Did you see it erupt?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}? {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? What's up? What's with those faces?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You look like a pair of detectives from a light novel who've suddenly realized the truth about the killer...

choices.text: We saw some sort of "truth," alright...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (You explain what you saw to Paimon...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Huh? You saw the same stuff you did when we first arrived in Natlan and met {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And some strange images?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Ehrr?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You said you saw some strange words before... Umm, Paimon didn't see anything, so she can't be sure, but... might they have been written by the same person?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I think that's the case, yes...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, something feels fishy to Paimon... But, this time you also saw... a giant section of ruins, a broken city, and the Abyss...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And some "Sacred Mountain"... Hmm, don't the Natlanese call that volcano the "Sacred Mountain"? Could it be that what you saw has something to do with the volcano?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon can't shake the feeling that the person who united us with {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} really wants us to go there...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm. Do you think we can help the little one remove his... what was it called... Flamelord's Blessing? Y'know, if we get to that mountain?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, let's go there then. Gotta help you grow big and strong, after all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh right! One of the six tribes of Natlan, the Collective of Plenty, lives beside the volcano. Maybe we can ask them for help!

choices.text: The true identity of the cake murderer is... Paimon!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Darn it! How did you know? Paimon was certain no one saw her eating Little Miss Cake... Just kidding, Paimon actually stole the Blazed Meat Stew!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, you... Wait, what did you just see?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (You explain what you saw to Paimon...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, you saw some weird words again...
